criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: One goldenHour world, no frame in a void, 1, 6 and 7 closest to a place. The instanced far unit is a primitive box with a black square and dash vents filling 3, 4, 7, 8 and 9. Grounds are dead zones on 1, 2 and 3. Frame 2 shows serrated streaks on the end faces and only three enclosures read. Frame 5's door is a plate, the page a sticker, no visible sill dust. Frame 9's ridge a spiky black mass. Frame 4's tier starts about 38 px left of the Region 1 tick.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One deck, the 7 to 8 device lands, the camera move works, value holds 1 to 4 and 6 to 8. Frame 5 reads as an interior plate, frame 9's ridge reads as another world and barely carries the fence.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces. The block omits c20 and c46 ids. Frame 9 joins 1118 to residents. Frame 4's start at Region 1 is an inference from c13. The caption's closing question leans, since the proposed condition does assign the costs for the life.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, where, who decided and who decides next, a date and a concrete stake. No next step a Texan can take.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns it, 2 pays, 7 to 8 the best built moment, 9 closes. Frame 3 re-says the cover, 6 could move.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, strong hooks, leans on case language, regional texture only in place names.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Golden hour is fresh against 34 to 36. No. 32 gas engines on caliche, no. 36 a pipe rail ruler and one scale bar, a ground hex close to no. 36's, the type skeleton unchanged.

one_sentence_fix: Replace the instanced far unit with a reduced detail of the hero's louvre and roof geometry and give the grounds real caliche surface with scatter and contact.
